meta.title: Multi Currency, Currency Switcher, Exchange Rates for WooCommerce - Mudra demo
meta.author: blazecommerce

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
$items = array(
	array( 'Classic Leather Wallet', '49', 'WALLET-01' ),
	array( 'Canvas Weekend Bag', '129', 'BAG-02' ),
	array( 'Ceramic Pour-Over Set', '64', 'POUR-03' ),
	array( 'Merino Wool Beanie', '35', 'BEANIE-04' ),
);
foreach ( $items as $item ) {
	$p = new WC_Product_Simple();
	$p->set_name( $item[0] );
	$p->set_regular_price( $item[1] );
	$p->set_sku( $item[2] );
	$p->set_status( 'publish' );
	$p->save();
}
global $wpdb;
$rates = array(
	array( 'USD', 'left', 1 ),
	array( 'EUR', 'right_space', 0.92 ),
	array( 'GBP', 'left', 0.79 ),
	array( 'AUD', 'left', 1.52 ),
);
foreach ( $rates as $rate ) {
	$wpdb->insert( $wpdb->prefix . 'woocommerce_exchange_rate', array( 'currency_code' => $rate[0], 'currency_pos' => $rate[1], 'currency_exchange_rate' => $rate[2] ) );
}
update_option( 'widget_woo_exchange_rate_widget', array( 2 => array( 'title' => 'Currency' ), '_multiwidget' => 1 ) );
$sidebars              = get_option( 'sidebars_widgets', array() );
$sidebars['sidebar-1'] = array( 'woo_exchange_rate_widget-2' );
update_option( 'sidebars_widgets', $sidebars );
flush_rewrite_rules();
